stem:
A scientist finds the plant fossil shown.

Which question can the scientist most likely answer by examining this fossil?

options.label: A
options.text: What was the average monthly rainfall in the area?

options.label: B
options.text: How much water was absorbed by the roots of the plant?

options.label: C
options.text: How much oxygen was in the atmosphere surrounding the plant?

options.label: D
options.text: What was the environment like in the area when the plant was alive?
